subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He used to ______ letters to his parents from Bangalore.
solution:
The correct answer is **"write."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Write"** is the correct spelling for the action of composing written communication. (लिखना (काग़ज़ पर क़लम या पेंसिल से))

 
 
• **Example**: ***Write**__ your name on the paper.*
 
 
 
• Here, we are talking about a letter, so the correct choice must be **"write."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct sentence**: *He used to __**write**__ letters to his parents from Bangalore.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Wright"** is a surname and can also refer to a skilled worker, such as a shipwright or wheelwright. (एक कुशल श्रमिक)
 
• **"Rite"** can also refer to a particular style or manner of doing something, such as a dance rite. (वर्ग विशेष द्वारा (प्रायः धार्मिक प्रयोजन से) किया गया अनुष्‍ठान)
 
• **"Right"** can also mean a legal entitlement or permission, such as the right to vote. (शुद्घ, सही; सच)
